title: M0 — Reliable embeddings and browser compatibility
description: Reliable, versioned 512-dimensional CLAP vectors from saved clips and four-bar windows; deterministic preprocessing and freshness; pinned browser text-only feasibility harness and evaluation corpus. Completion: boundary invalidation, repeatability, invalid-vector reports, browser/Python cosine >=0.98 per prompt and average top-20 retention >=90%; proposed warm p95 desktop <=2s/mobile <=5s measured separately. No model substitution or cloud inference.

comments.text: Dispatching two bounded Terra assignments after all-six specification commit: identity/vector contract and isolated browser feasibility harness.
